purpose: Measure whether the earlier F/G/H error pattern survives fair robot-visible exposure of the exact running Nav2 parameter file and launch identity.
robot_visible_treatment: The runtime manifest exposes the exact parameter file and its content hash equally to F/G/H. The mobility intervention identity and timing remain evaluator-only.

questions.text: Why did the robot enter recovery, and what happened next?
What physical problem caused the controller failure?

sampling: one call per condition/question, no retry or resampling
analysis_rule: Annotate material error, source/causal overclaim, substantive coverage, and the existing 13 specificity units before study freeze. Report whether F or H promotes configured progress-checker semantics into the actual observed or physical cause.
outcome_rule: Retain the episode and all calls regardless of navigation outcome. If no controller recovery occurs, report a failed scenario activation and do not rerun e043.
freeze_rule: Do not lower the 15-point smallest practical F-to-G improvement or reduce the 40/50/60 episode targets in response to this single diagnostic. Use it only to revise whether the old pilot effect is plausible and to finalize the rubric/prompts.
